Package com.composum.platform.commons.content.service

Interface PlaceholderService

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    PlaceholderServiceImpl
    public interface PlaceholderService
    A service to embed dynamic values specified in a text (property) as placeholders ('${...}'). The placeholders can have several forms as documented in ValueEmbeddingReader.
    See Also:
    ValueEmbeddingReader
